# factory-lang-python

Render Python manifests from the workspace composition.

An MCP engine. forge resolves it by URI and calls a tool over stdio.

```yaml
engine: forge://github.com/alexandremahdhaoui/forge-factory/cmd/factory-lang-python@v0.1.0
```

## Tools

| Tool | Does | Input | Output |
|---|---|---|---|
| `language` | Report which language this engine speaks. | `RenderInput` | `LanguageOutput` |
| `render` | Render every python manifest the workspace needs. | `RenderInput` | `RenderOutput` |
| `describe` | Describe the runtime this language's members exec - artifacts, layout, env, prerequisites. Pure data. | `DescribeInput` | `RuntimeDescription` |

## Running it by hand

```sh
go run ./cmd/factory-lang-python --mcp
```

It speaks JSON-RPC on stdin and stdout. Logs go to stderr, because
anything else corrupts the stream.
